snntorch.epoch_metric_scope: fixed weights after each completed epoch
snntorch.timing_scope: setup, training, initial/epoch train/test evaluations and in-memory checkpoint construction; excludes warmup, disk writes and Modal commits

snnlab.timing_scope: setup, training, initial/epoch train/test evaluations and in-memory checkpoint construction; excludes warmup, disk writes and Modal commits

training_timing.scope: complete train call after argument validation; excludes caller preparation and persistence unless save_*_checkpoint is requested
training_timing.training_scope: minibatch preparation, forward/loss/backward, optimizer/constraints, update bookkeeping and in-loop checkpoint selection; excludes epoch evaluations

snnlab.epoch_metric_scope: fixed weights after each completed epoch

profiling.scope: CUDA-synchronized wall latency; forward includes fresh state; backward excludes forward/loss preparation; no Adam or transfers; randomized interleaving on one L4
